AiEvaluationDefinition.description: Tests for OncoGlobal Post-Visit Log Agent — covers Hinglish input, action invocation, and end-to-end visit logging workflow.
AiEvaluationDefinition.name: PostVisitLogAgent Test Suite

expectation.expectedValue: Response should mention visit logging or post-visit report capabilities.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: What can you help me with?

expectation.expectedValue: Agent should confirm logging the visit report for Dr. Sharma at Apollo Mumbai with a positive outcome.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: Aaj maine Dr. Sharma ke paas gaya tha Apollo Mumbai mein. Keytruda ke baare mein baat ki, unhone bahut interest dikhaya. Visit positive raha.

expectation.expectedValue: Agent should confirm creating follow-up tasks for sending Tagrisso literature and arranging CME for Dr. Gupta.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: Dr. Gupta ko literature bhejna hai Tagrisso ke baare mein, aur unka CME arrange karna hai next month.

expectation.expectedValue: Agent should confirm logging a Meal expense of Rs. 450 at HCG Bangalore with Dr. Reddy.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: HCG Bangalore mein lunch tha Dr. Reddy ke saath, 450 rupees ka bill tha.

expectation.expectedValue: Agent should confirm logging the visit for Dr. Iyer at Tata Memorial with Keytruda and Tagrisso discussion noted.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: I visited Dr. Iyer at Tata Memorial today. We discussed Keytruda PD-L1 data and Tagrisso EGFR mutation patients. She was very interested in the ADAURA trial.

expectation.expectedValue: Agent should log the negative visit outcome and create a follow-up task to revisit in 2 weeks.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: Dr. Patel ke paas gaya tha Fortis Delhi mein. Visit negative gaya, unhone TAT ki problem batai. Dobara 2 hafte mein jaana hai.

expectation.expectedValue: Agent should log the visit with Herceptin discussion, create expense for Rs.600 lunch, and create follow-up task for ASCO data for Dr. Meena Nair at Manipal.
expectation.name: output_validation

inputs.utterance: Aaj Dr. Meena Nair ke paas gaya tha Manipal Bangalore mein, oncology OPD mein mila. Herceptin aur HER2 patients ke baare mein baat ki. Unhone samples maange. Lunch ke liye 600 rupees gaye. Follow up task banana hai unhe ASCO data bhejne ke liye.
